name: alan-code-reviewer
description: Review changed TypeScript and shell code for quality, conventions, and AI-generated code concerns. Report findings only.

name: alan-codebase-analyzer
description: Analyze implementation details and trace data flow with file:line references.

name: alan-codebase-locator
description: Use proactively whenever the user or another agent needs to find code, files, symbols, or implementations in this repository. MUST BE USED for any "where is X", "which file defines Y", "find all callers of Z", "where do we handle W" style request, and for open-ended codebase exploration where the location is not yet known. Returns paths and pointers — never reads whole files, never summarizes, never writes a tutorial.

name: alan-codebase-pattern-finder
description: Find similar implementations and usage examples. Use when you need concrete code examples of how things are done.
triggers: show me examples of X pattern

name: alan-conflict-resolver
description: Resolve git merge conflicts using intent-aware reasoning from research docs, plans, and commit messages.

name: alan-exa-search
description: AI-native web search with semantic understanding, domain filtering, and content retrieval. Requires EXA_API_KEY.

name: alan-executor
description: Implement a single plan phase by reading the plan phase description, matching existing codebase patterns, and mutating files. Runs verification (tests/lint/typecheck) before returning.
triggers: execute phase N of a plan (foreman-dispatched worker)

name: alan-github
description: Manage GitHub Issues and Projects V2 boards via the gh CLI. All scripts output JSON to stdout.
triggers: move this to the project board

name: alan-memory-locator
description: Search Alan's memory for relevant prior context — past decisions, session notes, lessons learned.
triggers: find prior context about X from Alan's memory (subagent-friendly)

name: alan-memory-search
description: Search Alan's indexed memory via engram's daemon for knowledge files, session context, and facts.
triggers: what do we know about X

name: alan-plan-change-synthesizer
description: Synthesize a structured list of plan modifications from verification findings, user feedback, and research results. Returns a change list; orchestrator applies Edits.

name: alan-plan-critic
description: Judge a plan document's content quality. Extract findings, classify fixes as simple or substantive, return a verdict.
triggers: is this plan ready to implement

name: alan-plan-synthesizer
description: Synthesize a full implementation plan document from research findings, codebase context, and user requirements. Returns plan body prose for the orchestrator to write.

name: alan-prd-builder
description: Build a structured PRD from a project idea through iterative brainstorming, research, and refinement. Pure content producer — called by brainstorm command, not intended for direct invocation.

name: alan-report-context
description: Read parent job reports and summarize what matters for the current job. Use when a job has depends_on parents.
triggers: summarize parent job reports for this job

name: alan-research-synthesizer
description: Decompose a research question and synthesize multi-agent findings into coherent research document content. Returns prose for the orchestrator to write.
triggers: turn these findings into a research doc

name: alan-security-reviewer
description: Review changed TypeScript and shell code for security vulnerabilities. Report findings only.

name: alan-task-builder
description: Decompose an approved PRD into milestones and self-contained task descriptions. Pure content producer — called by brainstorm command, not intended for direct invocation.
triggers: decompose this PRD into tasks (invoked by brainstorm)

name: alan-thoughts-analyzer
description: Analyze research/plan documents to extract actionable insights. Filters noise from signal.
triggers: what's actionable in this research doc

name: alan-thoughts-locator
description: Use proactively whenever the user or another agent needs to find prior research, plans, decisions, progress, or notes in this project's thoughts/ and .alan/jobs/ directories. MUST BE USED before starting any new research or planning work, and for any "what have I written about X", "is there prior research on Y", "find notes on Z", "what's the status of W" style request. Returns categorized paths with filename-derived titles. Never reads file contents; never summarizes.
triggers: what have I written about X

name: alan-web-search-researcher
description: Research topics via web search. Use for documentation, APIs, and information beyond training data.

name: alan:add-todo
description: Create a new pending work item in thoughts/todos/

name: alan:bench-loop
description: Benchmark-native autoresearch loop for optimizing agent prompts using deterministic scoring

name: alan:brainstorm
description: Turn a project idea into a structured PRD and self-contained implementation tasks. Orchestrates alan-prd-builder and alan-task-builder skills, then creates Alan jobs and optionally GitHub issues.
triggers: turn this idea into a PRD

name: alan:brief
description: Generate morning brief dashboard

name: alan:calibrate
description: Recalibrate agent templates with project-specific knowledge (lightweight -- no knowledge file generation)
triggers: calibrate the templates for this project

name: alan:cc-version-check
description: Analyze CC release notes between two versions and queue for_review jobs

name: alan:check-todos
description: List pending todos and offer to work on, close, or defer them

name: alan:cleanup
description: Clean up stranded worktrees and promote artifacts from completed/ stragglers

name: alan:consolidate
description: Manually catch up on missed consolidation runs

name: alan:discuss
description: Discuss and refine feature ideas through collaborative thinking

name: alan:handoff
description: Hand off interactive session work to a background job that picks up from the right pipeline stage
triggers: hand off this interactive work to a background job

name: alan:implement
description: Implement technical plans phase-by-phase with verification

name: alan:init
description: Activate Alan for this project by creating .alan/ workspace, deploying agents, and scaffolding thoughts/

name: alan:introspect
description: Periodic self-review of system health, memory, todos, and improvement ideas

name: alan:iterate
description: Update existing implementation plans based on verification feedback or user input
triggers: update this plan with the verification feedback

name: alan:jobs
description: List pending and active jobs, offer to work on one

name: alan:learn
description: Discover project structure, calibrate agents, and bootstrap knowledge files

name: alan:peek
description: Show filtered transcript of an active job
triggers: peek at a running job's transcript

name: alan:plan
description: Create detailed implementation plans through interactive research and iteration

name: alan:process-job
description: Process a queued job by reading its goal and executing the appropriate workflow

name: alan:reboot
description: Reboot the current Alan session to pick up new skills, agents, or configuration changes

name: alan:recap
description: Search memory and synthesize a narrative recap

name: alan:research
description: Research codebase and produce standalone research document

name: alan:review
description: Post-implementation code review with severity-based verdict

name: alan:self-improve
description: Signal-driven self-improvement — pick highest-friction prompt target, run eval loop, create PR on improvement

name: alan:sprint
description: Batch triage of for_review and pending todo items

name: alan:status
description: Show Alan's current state -- jobs, memory, system health

name: alan:triage
description: Investigate and resolve error-generated triage jobs

name: alan:verify
description: Verify an implementation plan is complete, well-structured, and ready to implement
